stories.title: La Fed de Warsh desafía a Trump y sube tipos al 4%

en.title: Warsh's Fed Defies Trump and Raises Rates to 4%
en.summary: The U.S. Federal Reserve increased interest rates by a quarter point to a range of 3.75% to 4%, the first increase since summer 2023. The unanimous decision aims to control current inflationary pressures.

stories.title: La Reserva Federal desafía a Trump al subir por unanimidad los tipos de interés a mes y medio de las elecciones

en.title: Federal Reserve Defies Trump by Unanimously Raising Interest Rates One and a Half Months Before Elections
en.summary: Kevin Warsh, in his first major decision leading the Fed, raised interest rates by a quarter point, with additional increases expected this year. Trump responded by calling for rapid rate cuts.

stories.title: Los insultos desde Marruecos a Abde provocaron el "no" de Mbappé, Vinicius y Konaté a lucir la camiseta de apoyo a Ceuta

en.title: Insults from Morocco to Abde prompted Mbappé, Vinicius and Konaté to refuse to wear Ceuta support shirt
en.summary: Three football players declined to participate in a support initiative for Ceuta after learning about controversy involving player Abde in the hours before a match, seeking to avoid negative reactions from the neighboring country.

stories.title: Mbappé se explica tras esconder el apoyo a Ceuta

en.title: Mbappé Explains Himself After Hiding Support for Ceuta
en.summary: Real Madrid forward Kylian Mbappé explained his decision to avoid displaying a message of support for Ceuta before a match. He stated his gesture was intended to show solidarity with immigrants facing difficult conditions.

stories.title: El Gobierno muestra su “perplejidad” por el freno de la Audiencia Nacional al campamento para inmigrantes del Puerto de Ceuta

en.title: Government Expresses "Bewilderment" Over National Court's Halt to Immigrant Camp at Port of Ceuta
en.summary: The Spanish government expressed confusion over a National Court decision blocking an immigrant camp at Ceuta's port. Government sources stated the measure prevents implementing an immediate operational solution on the ground.

stories.title: Mbappé explica por qué no se enfundó la camiseta en apoyo a Ceuta: “Quería tener también un gesto con los inmigrantes”

en.title: Mbappé explains why he did not wear the shirt in support of Ceuta: "I wanted to also make a gesture with immigrants"
en.summary: Mbappé clarified his decision not to wear a solidarity shirt for Ceuta that some clubs adopted following a campaign by Valencian businessmen, stating he wanted to acknowledge immigrants who have lost their lives.

stories.title: Mbappé rompe su silencio tras la polémica por Ceuta: "Quería tener un pensamiento con todos los inmigrantes que han perdido la vida"

en.title: Mbappé breaks his silence after the Ceuta controversy: "I wanted to have a thought for all the immigrants who have lost their lives"
en.summary: Mbappé stated he has solidarity with Ceuta while explaining that the decision to wear the shirt was made by clubs, not players.

stories.title: La Reserva Federal cede a la presión inflacionaria y sube los tipos un cuarto de punto

en.title: The Federal Reserve yields to inflationary pressure and raises rates by a quarter point
en.summary: The Federal Reserve increased interest rates to a range of 3.75%-4%, amid continued inflation driven by rising gasoline prices and cost of living affected by the Iran conflict.

stories.title: La Fed desafía a Trump al subir los tipos de interés un cuarto de punto por primera vez en tres años

en.title: The Fed defies Trump by raising interest rates by a quarter point for the first time in three years
en.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh raised interest rates despite pressure from President Trump, who appointed him specifically to lower borrowing costs, citing inflation driven by the Iran conflict and tariffs.

stories.title: Mbappé: “Me solidarizo con Ceuta, pero también quería tener un gesto con los inmigrantes”

en.title: Mbappé: "I show solidarity with Ceuta, but I also wanted to make a gesture with immigrants"
en.summary: Mbappé explains his decision to conceal his shirt during a match, stating he supports Ceuta while also seeking to send a message of positivity and peace regarding immigrants.

stories.title: Atlético de Madrid y Osasuna muestran una pancarta de apoyo a Ceuta tras la polémica con Mbappé, Vinicius y Konaté

en.title: Atlético Madrid and Osasuna display banner of support for Ceuta following Mbappé, Vinicius and Konaté controversy
en.summary: Players from both clubs held a banner reading "All with Ceuta" in a show of support, contrasting with three Real Madrid players who concealed the message during their match.

stories.title: Qué es el movimiento ‘Todos somos caballas’ y por qué Vinicius, Mbappé y Konaté se negaron a secundarlo

en.title: What is the 'We are all caballas' movement and why did Vinicius, Mbappé and Konaté refuse to support it
en.summary: A campaign promoted by Valencian businessmen became the center of debate after three Real Madrid players concealed their shirts bearing the movement's message.

stories.title: DWS pone a la venta el centro comercial Diagonal Mar

en.title: DWS puts Diagonal Mar shopping center up for sale
en.summary: Deutsche Bank's real estate management division is seeking a buyer for the complex, which it purchased for 495 million euros a decade ago.

stories.title: Cofides se suma a Viserion en Elian con una inversión de 40 millones de euros

en.title: Cofides joins Viserion in Elian with a 40 million euro investment
en.summary: A Spanish state-owned company acquired a 13.8% stake in the owner of a soybean processing plant at Barcelona's port, which is undergoing expansion.

stories.title: Portobello levanta 710 millones y cierra el mayor fondo de capital riesgo español

en.title: Portobello raises 710 million and closes Spain's largest venture capital fund
en.summary: Portobello completed fundraising of 710 million euros for what is reported as Spain's largest venture capital fund.

stories.title: La Fed desafía a Trump y sube tipos, por primera vez en tres años, al 4%

en.title: The Fed defies Trump and raises rates for the first time in three years to 4%
en.summary: The Federal Reserve increased interest rates by 25 basis points to 4% in line with market expectations, despite pressure from the White House to lower them.

stories.title: El Congreso tumba la ley de 'lobbies' y anula el nuevo registro de grupos de interés

en.title: Congress defeats the lobbying law and nullifies the new interest groups registry
en.summary: The Spanish Congress rejected a government decree on lobbying regulation approved in August, potentially jeopardizing hundreds of millions in European fund payments.
